summary: This table presents an overview of client metrics for the quarters ending March 31, 2025, December 31, 2024, and March 31, 2024. It includes the number of active clients, clients added during the period, and the count of million-dollar clients across various thresholds. Notably, the number of active clients decreased slightly from 1,882 in March 2024 to 1,869 in March 2025. The table also highlights client contributions to revenues, with the top 5 clients contributing 13.1% in March 2025, a slight increase from 12.7% in December 2024. Additionally, the Days Sales Outstanding metric shows a decrease from 74 days in December 2024 to 69 days in March 2025, indicating improved efficiency in collections.
